title: 第17章 十姐的密探第18章 陛下这么希望镇北王造反吗
slug: 大婚之日我阉了未婚妻的白月光
content_zh:
全场死寂！
所有人都震惊的盯着叶凡！这是什么狼虎之词？
“啊？”
冷金秋懵了。
苏凝霜死死咬着红唇，一双眸子可以滴出水来，她直接从腰间拔出一把匕首，抵着自己的脖子：“王爷，你别逼我！”
配上那一副泫然欲泣，人见犹怜，楚楚可怜的表情。
无数纨绔和公子哥的心都要碎了，一个个对叶凡咬牙切齿，恨不得上去撕了他！
“主人，她在用媚功！”
脑海中传来混沌万物鼎的声音。
叶凡的脸一沉！
果然不是普通女人！
二楼环廊的林霄喝道：“叶凡，别以为你刚休了李幽若，就能染指凝霜姑娘！”
抬头一看。
林霄、袁子轩、周元礼三人冷漠的俯视着他！
“打断他们三个的腿，丢出去！”
叶凡头也不抬的下令。
“什么？你敢！”
三人变色。
数十名禁卫军冲上来！
“拦住他们！”

林霄大叫，身边的随从根本不是禁卫军的对手，全都被打的惨叫！
三人被扣住，还不知死活的低吼：“叶凡，我们是世子，你敢……”
手中刀鞘砸下，‘喀嚓’几声脆响，只剩下林霄三人的惨叫声。
直接从二楼丢出万花楼，凄惨的摔在外面的街道上！
“嘶！”
万花楼里的公子少爷们，吓得噤若寒蝉。
“你可以自杀！”
“我会让手下，把你的尸体带回去！”叶凡对苏凝霜说完，转身走出万花楼，钻进马车。
片刻之后，苏凝霜带着一张苍白的俏脸，伸出玉手推开马车的大门钻了进来，泪水在眸子里转动，憋着忍住不哭，身体一抽一抽的。
叶凡好笑！
大夏第一交际花，冰清玉洁？还不是怕死！
马车调转车头，朝着公爵府驶去。
叶凡冷笑：“别装了！你的媚功太低端。”
苏凝霜的美眸一缩，心中更是泛起惊涛骇浪：‘他怎么知道我会媚功？’
“王爷，您在说什么，我怎么听不不懂啊？”
“听不懂？好啊！那我们就聊一些你听得懂的！”叶凡也懒得再装，直接摊牌：“你是李悠然的人吧？”
“我身上的慢性毒，是你下的吧？”
“啊……”
苏凝霜更加震惊。
一双美眸瞪大！

下意识的后退，去抓腰间的匕首！
叶凡一抬手，一把镶嵌着宝石的匕首，出现在他手里：“你在找这个？”
苏凝霜的俏脸一变再变：“王爷！我没有对你下毒！”
content_en:
The whole place was dead silent!
Everyone stared at Ye Fan in shock! What kind of wolf-tiger words is this?
"Huh?"
Leng Jinqiu was stunned.
Su Ningshuang bit her red lips, her eyes could water. She pulled out a dagger from her waist and put it against her neck: "Your Majesty, don't force me!"
Coupled with that expression of being about to cry, people feel pity and tenderness.
The hearts of countless dandies and young masters were about to be broken. They all gnashed their teeth at Mark and wished they could go up and tear him apart!
"Master, she is using her charm skills!"
The voice of the Cauldron of Chaos came in his mind.
Ye Fan's face sank!
Sure enough, she is no ordinary woman!
Lin Xiao, who was in the corridor on the second floor, shouted: "Ye Fan, don't think that just because you divorced Li Youruo, you can get your hands on Miss Ningshuang!"
Look up.
Lin Xiao, Yuan Zixuan, and Zhou Yuanli looked down at him indifferently!
"Break the legs of three of them and throw them out!"
Ye Fan ordered without raising his head.
"What? How dare you!"
The three of them changed color.
Dozens of Imperial Guards rushed forward!
"Stop them!"
Lin Xiao shouted, the followers around him were no match for the Imperial Guards, they were all beaten and screamed!
The three of them were detained, and they shouted in a low voice without knowing whether to live or die: "Ye Fan, we are the prince, how dare you..."
The scabbard fell down in his hand, and there were a few crisp sounds, leaving only the screams of Lin Xiao and the others.
He was thrown directly from the second floor of Wanhua Tower and fell miserably on the street outside!
"Hiss!"
The young masters in Wanhua Tower were so frightened that they fell into silence.
"You can kill yourself!"
"I will ask my men to take your body back!" After Ye Fan said to Su Ningshuang, he turned around and walked out of Wanhua Building and got into the carriage.
A moment later, Su Ningshuang, with a pale and pretty face, stretched out her jade hand to push open the door of the carriage and got in. Tears rolled in her eyes. She was holding back her tears and her body was twitching.
Ye Fan is so funny!
The number one socialite in Daxia, pure and innocent? Not afraid of death!
The carriage turned around and drove towards the Duke's Palace.
Ye Fan sneered: "Stop pretending! Your charm skills are too low-end."
Su Ningshuang's beautiful eyes shrank, and her heart was filled with turmoil: 'How did he know that I knew how to charm? ’
"My lord, why can't I understand what you are talking about?"
"Don't you understand? Okay! Then let's talk about something you can understand!" Ye Fan didn't bother to pretend anymore and directly showed his cards: "Are you Li Youran's person?"
"The chronic poison in my body was caused by you, right?"
"Ah..."
Su Ningshuang was even more shocked.
A pair of beautiful eyes widened!
He subconsciously stepped back and grabbed the dagger at his waist!
As soon as Ye Fan raised his hand, a dagger inlaid with gems appeared in his hand: "Are you looking for this?"
Su Ningshuang's pretty face changed again and again: "Your Majesty! I didn't poison you!"
